name: directory.remove
description: Remove a directory. Empty directories require no flags. Pass `recursive=true` to remove a directory and all its contents (analogous to `rm -rf`). Hard delete — bypasses Recycle Bin / Trash. Makes something cease to be — classified D.

recursive.description: If true, recursively delete the directory's contents before removing the directory itself. Without this flag, removing a non-empty directory returns ERR not_empty.

entries_removed.description: Count of files + directories removed inside the target when recursive=true. 0 for a non-recursive empty-directory removal.

windows-modern.description: RemoveDirectoryW for the empty case. Recursive walk uses FindFirstFileW / FindNextFileW + DeleteFileW for files, RemoveDirectoryW for subdirectories. Reparse points are not traversed.

windows-classic.description: RemoveDirectory / RemoveDirectoryW per NT version. Same recursive walk pattern; reparse points not traversed.
